title: Multiplayer Breach queue stays side-safe through submit, reconnect and undo barrier
steps: A private multiplayer match is prepared with Deep Dive in Runner grip.
Runner submits Deep Dive with an idempotency key.
Duplicate submit returns the stored receipt.
Reconnect restores the Breach summary and legal access action without future card titles.
Runner accesses the first hidden queued card.
Undo after the hidden-info access event is blocked.
